manifest.title_fil: Pumili ng mga paraan ng pagkontrol
objectives_fil: Sa sitwasyon ng BHS, magmungkahi ng kontrol sa pinagmulan, kapaligiran, gawain at PPE na may tamang responsable.
objectives_en: For a BHS scenario, propose source, environmental, work-practice and PPE controls with appropriate owners.

sections.takeaway_fil: May mask, pero kulang ang proseso.
sections.takeaway_en: Masks are available; the process is incomplete.

sections.takeaway_fil: Punan ang apat na hanay: pinagmulan, kapaligiran, gawain at PPE. Isulat ang mungkahi at taong dapat magkumpirma.
sections.takeaway_en: Complete four rows: source, environment, work practices and PPE. Add a proposal and the person who must confirm it.

check.prompt_fil: May mask na sa kahon. Ano ang dapat isipin ng BHW?
check.prompt_en: Masks are available. What should the BHW consider?

options.fil: Suriin din ang lugar at proseso.
options.en: Check the setting and process too.

options.fil: Hindi na kailangang ipaalam ang sintomas sa clinical staff.
options.en: Symptoms no longer need reporting to clinical staff.

options.fil: Wala nang panganib dahil may mask na magagamit.
options.en: There is no remaining risk because masks are available.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi naaayos ng mask ang saradong bintana at malabong proseso; suriin din ang mga ito. 2: Kailangan pa rin ang napagkasunduang pag-uulat. 3: Hindi inaalis ng isang gamit ang lahat ng panganib.
check.feedback_en: 1: Masks alone leave the closed window and unclear process; check those too. 2: The agreed reporting process still applies. 3: One item does not remove every risk.

sections.takeaway_fil: Staff ang nagtuturo ng waiting area at mask; sa responsable ang concern sa bentilasyon.
sections.takeaway_en: Staff set the waiting area and mask; the ventilation concern goes to the responsible person.

sections.takeaway_fil: Huwag baguhin mag-isa ang bentilasyon o isolation; hindi sapat ang mask sa lahat ng exposure.
sections.takeaway_en: Do not change ventilation or isolation alone; a mask is not enough for every exposure.

sections.takeaway_fil: May tamang pagsusuri at pag-aayos ng facility.
sections.takeaway_en: This enables appropriate facility review and action.

check.prompt_fil: May concern sa bentilasyon. Ano ang tamang susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: There is a ventilation concern. What is the appropriate next step?

options.fil: Ilipat agad ang lahat sa silid na hindi pa nasusuri.
options.en: Immediately move everyone to a room that has not been assessed.
Report it and have the responsible person review it.

options.fil: Sabihing ligtas ang silid kahit walang anumang pagsusuri.
options.en: Declare the room safe without any assessment.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring hindi angkop ang bagong lugar. 2: May tamang pagsusuri at pag-aayos ng facility. 3: Walang sapat na batayan ang katiyakan.
check.feedback_en: 1: The new location may be unsuitable. 2: This enables appropriate facility review and action. 3: The reassurance lacks a basis.

sections.takeaway_fil: Gumawa ng mapa ng apat na uri ng kontrol para sa fictional na BHS, may responsable ang bawat isa.
sections.takeaway_en: Map the four control types for a fictional BHS, each with an owner.

assets.caption_fil: May kontrol sa apat na uri, malinaw na responsable at walang sariling pagbabago sa clinical o engineering na proseso.
